body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> SONY(www.sony.com) introduced 'VAIO F Series', a full HD 3D laptop at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
It features 1920x1080 resolution and loads 16-inch LED display.
